mandate: C431 — test the price-only CROSS-QUANTILOGRAM ρ_τ(k) (Han–Linton–Oka 2016) quantile-conditional directional tail-dependence stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). Quantile levels τ∈{0.10,0.25,0.75,0.90} (0.50 excluded). Causal trailing quantile q_τ^X[t]=τ-quantile of {X[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128). Quantile-hit process h_τ^X[t]=1{X[t]≤q_τ^X[t]}. Cross-quantilogram at lag k≥0: ρ_τ(k;X,Y)=[(1/(T-k))Σ_t(h_τ^X[t]-τ)(h_τ^Y[t-k]-τ)]/(τ(1-τ)), the Pearson correlation of the two hit-indicator series; per-bar feature = trailing-window average of (h_τ^X[t]-τ)(h_τ^Y[t-k]-τ)/(τ(1-τ)). Four concepts: cq_serial=mean over τ,k∈{1,2,4} ρ_τ(k;r[t],r[t-k]); cq_volserial=mean over τ,k ρ_τ(k;a[t],a[t-k]); cq_market=mean over τ,k ρ_τ(k;r_i[t],m[t-k]); cq_signmag=mean over τ ρ_τ(0;1{r[t]>0},1{a[t]≤q_τ^a[t]}). NaN if t<W_q or any NaN/non-finite in the trailing window or degenerate window or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (cq_serial_dev, cq_volserial_dev, cq_market_dev, cq_signmag_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates of the real return-derived CQ series, never market data, never fabricated). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W_q or NaN in trailing window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: quantile levels τ∈{0.10,0.25,0.75,0.90}; trailing quantile window W_q=256 (fallback 128); quantile-hit h_τ[t]=1{X[t]≤q_τ[t]}; cross-quantilogram ρ_τ(k;X,Y)=mean_t(h_τ^X[t]-τ)(h_τ^Y[t-k]-τ)/(τ(1-τ)); concepts cq_serial/cq_volserial/cq_market/cq_signmag over lags {1,2,4} (signmag at lag 0).
methodology.signals: cq_serial_dev/cq_volserial_dev/cq_market_dev/cq_signmag_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over W_q=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal of the real return-derived CQ series; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.cq_vectorization_note: hit processes computed once per (series,τ); per-bar ρ_τ(k)=trailing mean of (hx-τ)(hy[t-k]-τ)/(τ(1-τ)) via NaN-aware cumulative sums, O(N) per (signal,lookback); concept = mean over τ,k. Validated against a naive per-window cross-quantilogram reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
